display.purpose: Test title in the preview header; the largest weighted text per screen.

headline.purpose: Selected test row title, active-step banner step name.

title.purpose: The brand wordmark 'reactlens' in the header.

body.purpose: Every other piece of UI text; sentence-case.

label.purpose: Uppercase panel-header eyebrows (one per panel, never per-section).

code.purpose: React tree, prop/hook values, diff lines, file paths, kbd hints. JetBrains Mono 13.5/1.85.

shadows.name: window-ambient
shadows.purpose: The app window's soft floating-over-the-desk drop shadow. The only persistent shadow on the UI.

shadows.name: modal-lift
shadows.purpose: Apply Fix confirmation card. Heavier because it interrupts the flow.

shadows.name: step-pill-active
shadows.purpose: On the currently-active fail step pill in the timeline. Indigo-tinted; the shadow itself carries the brand.

shadows.name: stat-dot-halo
shadows.purpose: Soft ring around failing test status dots. Reads as a pulse, not a depth shadow.

motion.name: row-hover
motion.purpose: Test rows, filter chips: subtle hover lift.

motion.name: tree-node-hover
motion.purpose: Component tree node hover; slightly slower than body rows because the tree is the hero surface.

breakpoints.name: desktop
breakpoints.purpose: 3-col default: tests / preview / inspector at the configured min-widths.

breakpoints.name: tight
breakpoints.purpose: 3-col tighter: sidebars yield ground first, preview keeps breathing room.

breakpoints.name: compact
breakpoints.purpose: Test list collapses to horizontal pill strip above; 2-col preview + inspector below.

breakpoints.name: stacked
breakpoints.purpose: Vertical stack: tests strip on top, preview, inspector tabs below.

components.name: Primary Button (Apply Fix)
components.description: Affirmative-action button. Indigo solid; never red.

components.name: Ghost Button (Copy as git apply)
components.description: Secondary action. Transparent fill, muted text.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--color-muted, #6b7480); padding: 4px 12px; font: 400 11px 'Inter', -apple-system, sans-serif; line-height: 1.3; border: 1px solid var(--color-border, #e3e7ee); border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--color-panel-2, #f3f5f9); }

components.name: Fail Stat Pill
components.description: Header stat pill for failed test count.
components.css: .ds-pill-fail { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; padding: 4px 9px; border-radius: 999px; font: 600 11.5px 'Inter', sans-serif; font-feature-settings: 'tnum'; background: var(--color-fail-soft, #fdecec); color: var(--color-fail-ink, #861c20); border: 1px solid rgba(229,72,77,0.20); white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Selected Test Row
components.description: Test list row when selected. Lens Mist fill + indigo ring + accent-ink title.
components.html: cart shows the correct subtotal6118ms
components.css: .ds-test-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 14px 1fr auto; gap: 10px; align-items: center; padding: 8px 10px; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--color-accent-soft, #ecebff); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(90,87,230,0.20); cursor: pointer; } .ds-test-row__dot { width: 9px; height: 9px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--color-fail, #e5484d); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(229,72,77,0.10); } .ds-test-row__title { font: 500 13px 'Inter', sans-serif; color: var(--color-accent-ink, #3d3ab8); white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .ds-test-row__duration { font: 400 11px 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-feature-settings: 'tnum'; color: var(--color-muted, #6b7480); }

components.name: Real-Bug Badge
components.description: Diagnosis classification badge for real-bug verdicts.
components.css: .ds-badge-real-bug { display: inline-block; padding: 2px 9px; border-radius: 999px; font: 600 11px 'Inter', sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.03em; background: var(--color-fail-soft, #fdecec); color: var(--color-fail, #e5484d); }

components.name: Tab (selected)
components.description: Inspector tab when selected. Lifted off the tablist with a soft shadow.
components.css: .ds-tab--selected { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 5px 12px; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--color-window, #fff); color: var(--color-accent-ink, #3d3ab8); border: 1px solid var(--color-border-strong, #d6dbe5); font: 600 11px 'Inter', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.07em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(40,49,64,0.04); } .ds-tab__dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--color-fail, #e5484d); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(229,72,77,0.10); }

components.name: Search Input (test filter)
components.description: Filter tests by name. Cmd+F focuses globally.
components.html: ⌘F
components.css: .ds-search { position: relative; } .ds-search input { width: 100%; padding: 7px 36px 7px 30px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border-strong, #d6dbe5); background: var(--color-window, #fff); border-radius: 8px; font: 400 12.5px 'Inter', sans-serif; color: var(--color-text, #2a3140); outline: none; } .ds-search input::placeholder { color: var(--color-muted-2, #8a93a0); } .ds-search input:focus { border-color: var(--color-accent, #5a57e6); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(90,87,230,0.12); } .ds-search__icon { position: absolute; left: 10px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); width: 13px; height: 13px; color: var(--color-muted, #6b7480); pointer-events: none; } .ds-search__kbd { position: absolute; right: 6px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); font: 600 10px 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; background: var(--color-panel-2, #f3f5f9); color: var(--color-muted, #6b7480); padding: 2px 5px; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border, #e3e7ee); pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Tree Node (active-owner)
components.description: The signature: a React fiber rendered as syntax-coloured JSX, marked as the current Playwright step's owner.
components.html: ▾<CartPage>
components.css: .ds-tree-node { position: relative; display: block; padding: 1px 8px; margin: 0 -8px; border-radius: 4px; font: 400 13.5px/1.85 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; letter-spacing: -0.005em; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-tree-node--active { background: var(--color-evidence-bg, #fef3c7); } .ds-tree-node--active::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 8px; right: 8px; bottom: 2px; height: 2px; background: var(--color-accent, #5a57e6); border-radius: 1px; } .ds-tree-toggle { color: var(--color-muted-2, #8a93a0); width: 14px; display: inline-block; } .ds-tree-tag { color: var(--color-code-tag, #4c46d8); font-weight: 600; } .ds-tree-punct { color: var(--color-code-punct, #94a3b8); }

components.name: Step Pill (active fail)
components.description: Active failing step in the timeline. Solid indigo with indigo-tinted shadow.
components.css: .ds-step-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 5px 10px; background: var(--color-accent, #5a57e6); color: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--color-accent, #5a57e6); border-radius: 8px; font: 600 11.5px 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(90,87,230,0.30); } .ds-step-pill__glyph { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; }

narrative.overview: reactlens is the workspace of a careful technician. The dashboard is the bench: flat, well-lit, materials laid out where you need them. The React component tree is the movement under the loupe, magnified and rendered as code so you can read the gears. The browser-window chrome places the work in a frame without dressing it. Every other element of the dashboard exists to serve the moment of diagnosis: which test failed, what the component was rendering, where in the code to make the change. The voice is Technical, Honest, Opinionated. The aesthetic is product-restrained: dense where information demands it, generous where the operator needs to breathe. Indigo is the brand but appears on ≤10% of any surface; it carries selection, primary action, and the brand mark, nothing decorative.
keyCharacteristics: Layered light surfaces, each ~1-2% luminance step apart, so depth reads without grayness.
Two-family typography: Inter for sans, JetBrains Mono for code. No display face; weight contrast carries hierarchy.
Semantic colour triplets (base / soft / ink) per state — pass / fail / warn / skip.
ARIA tree pattern + full keyboard navigation + WCAG 2.2 AA contrast.
3-column grid that collapses through 3 breakpoints to a stacked phone layout.

rules.name: The 10% Indigo Rule
rules.body: Probe Indigo and its derivatives appear on ≤10% of any rendered surface. Its rarity is the point: it is what the operator is supposed to look at.

rules.name: The Triplet Rule
rules.body: Every semantic state colour ships as a triplet: base / soft / ink. Pills use bg = soft, text = ink, border = base at 18-25% alpha.

rules.name: The Same-Code-Two-Surfaces Rule
rules.body: The component tree and the patch diff both render code; both must use the code-syntax palette unmodified. A `return` keyword in the tree and a `return` keyword in a patch are the same colour.

rules.name: The Hero-Is-The-Tree Rule
rules.body: The component tree is rendered at 13.5px JetBrains Mono with the 1.85 line-height. It is the only display surface in the dashboard.

rules.name: The One-Eyebrow-Per-Panel Rule
rules.body: Each panel may declare one uppercase Label header. Sub-sections inside the panel must use other weight + size contrasts, never additional eyebrows.

rules.name: The No-Display-Font Rule
rules.body: Two families total: Inter + JetBrains Mono. No serif, no extra sans, no display face.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Depth comes from luminance steps and 1px borders, not from shadows.

rules.name: The Ambient-Only Rule
rules.body: Shadows are atmospheric: they signal that something floats, lifts, or pulses; never that something is heavy.

dos: Do preserve the layered light surface scale.
Do ship semantic state colours as triplets.
Do render the React component tree and code patches with the same code-syntax palette.
Do use Inter for UI; JetBrains Mono for code. Two families, no exceptions.
Do keep new components flat by default.
Do wire keyboard navigation on every interactive component.
donts: Don't add a side stripe greater than 1px as a colored accent.
Don't add a third type family.
Don't use uppercase eyebrows on every section.
Don't look like Cypress, Vitest UI, Storybook, Sentry, Datadog, or Grafana.
Don't use Stop Signal red for affirmative actions.
Don't ship a status dot whose meaning depends only on colour.
Don't render code as plain text.
